levels.title: Level 1 — Stop the Clock
levels.subtitle: Click the button when the countdown hits 0.00.

levels.title: Level 2 — Digit Drop
levels.subtitle: Drop the virtual timer to truncate time, or wait. Click at 0!

levels.title: Level 3 — Clear Path
levels.subtitle: Drag the blue block to the trash, then click the button.

levels.title: Level 4 — Negative Sign
levels.subtitle: Remove the negative sign to see the true time, or wait.

levels.title: Level 5 — Pulley
levels.subtitle: Jump on the platform to raise the panel, then reach the button.
